title: The Fish Shop
lines: Kim sells fish in a dish.
A cat runs in the shop.
It picks up a big fish.
Kim yells, and the cat runs off.
The cat naps in a shed.
The fish is not in the dish.
Kim shuts the shop and gets a dog.

questions.ask: What does the cat take from the shop?
questions.listenFor: A big fish. It is stated in the story - send them back to that line if they are not sure.

questions.ask: Where does the cat go with the fish?
questions.listenFor: To a shed, where it naps. If they say only "away," ask them to find the word that names the place.

questions.ask: Why do you think Kim gets a dog? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any reason tied to the story works - "to keep cats out" shows they connected the ending to the problem.
